name: zoomable-image
title: Zoomable image
description: An image you can zoom in place: click or tap for 2x, wheel or pinch for more, drag to pan, and buttons and keys for everyone else.
docs: Click or tap toggles 2x around the point you hit, Ctrl or Cmd with the wheel and a pinch zoom up to maxZoom (4 by default), and a drag pans without the edge of the picture ever showing. Zoom in, Zoom out and a Reset button that shows the level sit in the corner; with the picture focused, + - and 0 zoom and the arrow keys move it. highResSrc is a sharper file, loaded the first time the zoom passes 1.5. A new src starts over at 100% and asks for its own sharper file only when it is looked at closely, so the picture can follow a thumbnail strip. onZoomChange gets the zoom, the step back to 1 included, ratio sets the frame, and labels and locale translate the names, hints and the level. Under reduced motion the zoom steps instantly.
